meta.name: user-story-splitting
meta.description: Break a large story or epic into smaller deliverable stories using proven split patterns. Use when backlog items are too big for estimation, sequencing, or independent release.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将大型用户故事拆分为可交付的小故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到过大、难以估算和排期的需求条目
copy.tagline_en: Break large user stories into deliverable smaller ones
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often have backlog items too big for estimation and sequencing

howto.what: 当用户给出一个过大的用户故事或史诗时，Claude 会使用 8 种拆分模式（如按工作流步骤、业务规则变体等）将其拆分为多个更小、可独立交付的故事，并输出每个拆分后的完整用户故事。
howto.when: 当用户输入一个过大、无法在一个冲刺内完成或独立发布的用户故事、史诗或特性时触发。用户可以直接在对话中粘贴故事文本，或仅提及拆分需求。

say.text: 拆分这个用户故事：作为管理员，我想批量导入用户。
say.note: Claude 会应用拆分模式生成多个小故事。

say.text: 帮我将史诗“用户管理”拆分成可交付的故事。
say.note: Claude 会按 8 种模式逐一检查并拆分。

say.text: 这个故事太大，无法估算，请拆分。
say.note: Claude 会询问故事文本并执行拆分。

howto.what_en: When given a large user story or epic, Claude uses 8 splitting patterns (e.g., workflow steps, business rule variations) to break it into smaller, independently deliverable stories, outputting each split as a complete user story.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user provides a story, epic, or feature that is too large for a single sprint or independent release. The user can paste the story text or simply mention the need to split.

say_en.text: Split this user story: As an admin, I want to bulk import users.
say_en.note: Claude will apply splitting patterns to generate smaller stories.

say_en.text: Break down the epic 'User Management' into deliverable stories.
say_en.note: Claude will check each of the 8 patterns and split accordingly.

say_en.text: This story is too big to estimate, please split it.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the story text and perform the split.
